change_class_rationale: Adds REPORT-ONLY `scripts/codex-thread-sweep.py` for inventorying unresolved codex review threads across open PRs. Tool is explicit about NOT batch-resolving — each thread must be per-thread audited + fixed OR per-thread rebutted with reason. Counter-design to the PR-82-class bulk-acknowledge anti-pattern.
task: Pipeline integration for codex review-thread handling. Replaces an earlier draft (with a `p2-only` bulk-resolve mode) that committed the anti-pattern + had to be reverted (47 unresolveReviewThread mutations).
local_gates: GraphQL queries dry-run via `list` mode return correct counts

findings: Single python script, std lib only + subprocess to gh CLI. No `p2-only` resolve mode — REPORT-ONLY by design. Docstring explicitly forbids bulk-resolve + links to PR #82 anti-pattern.

Embeds OP-11 (no stubs/no-defer): every codex thread must be fixed OR rebutted, never silently closed. Cites `require_conversation_resolution=true` branch-protection setting as the contract being enforced.
File at `scripts/codex-thread-sweep.py` matches existing `scripts/*.py` convention. `list` / `show` subcommand pattern matches existing oya-dev-cli surface.
Output format is grep-friendly (one line per thread with priority + path + title + id). Pipeline-integration section in docstring enumerates the workflow expectation.

architect.rationale: Counter-designs the PR-82-class anti-pattern: REPORT-ONLY surface forces per-thread audit rather than batch-close. Reuses agent-pre-push-validate.sh's shift-left philosophy for the human-review path.

critic.rationale: Caught earlier draft's bulk-resolve mode in pre-merge review. Memory file (feedback_codex_bulk_resolve_antipattern.md) documents the lesson for future sessions.
